feed.subtitle: Research papers and global crypto regulation, at a glance
feed.rights: Explanations and summaries are generated by AI from the original text. Dates, rates and amounts are checked against the source, but errors are still possible, so always rely on the original. Nothing here is legal, tax or investment advice.

entry.title: ADGM publishes guidance on crypto mining, the region's first such guidance from an international financial centre
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The ADGM Registration Authority has published guidance on crypto mining activities in and from ADGM, issued under section 23 of the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025. The guidance treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA rather than a regulated financial service. It takes a technology-neutral approach covering Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms. This is the first phase, with a regulatory framework to be developed and consulted on later.

entry.title: Circular on good practices for virtual asset service providers' public disclosures
entry.summary: Circular: Good practices for VASP’s public disclosures VARA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto VARA issued this circular based on a thematic review of public disclosures by licensed virtual asset service providers, setting out characteristics of good practice. It stresses treating disclosure as an ongoing compliance obligation and gives examples on pricing methodology, order routing and per-asset information. The circular is illustrative only and does not change any existing regulations or licence conditions.

entry.title: FCA opens crypto firm authorisation applications under new UK regime
entry.summary: FCA opens the gateway to regulated crypto FCA · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto The FCA announced that crypto firms can now apply for authorisation under the UK's new regime. Firms operating in the UK will be brought into full regulation, assessed against standards on consumer protection, safeguarding of customer assets, market integrity and financial resilience. Applications should be submitted by 28 February 2027, ahead of the regime's entry into force on 25 October 2027. Authorisation is not automatic, and firms that cannot meet the standards will not be permitted to operate in the UK market.

entry.title: UK regulator secures repayment for victims of crypto fraud
entry.summary: FCA secures money back for victims of crypto fraud FCA · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) obtained confiscation orders against Raymondip Bedi and Patrick Mavanga, who ran a fake cryptoasset investment scheme that defrauded at least 65 investors of £1,541,799. The court ordered Bedi to pay £603,404.28 and Mavanga to pay £247,997.99. Recovered funds will be returned to victims.

entry.title: FSA announces a supported project under its FinTech Experiment Hub and Payment Innovation Project (PIP)
entry.summary: 「FinTech実証実験ハブ・決済高度化プロジェクト（PIP）」支援決定案件の公表 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency has decided to support a demonstration experiment proposed by TradeWaltz, NTT Data, Mizuho Bank, MUFG Bank, SMBC, and Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking. The experiment tests practical use of stablecoins for funds settlement in trade transactions and sorts out related legal issues. It is expected to run from September 2026 for the time being, and results will be published afterward.

entry.title: Agenda for the First Meeting of the On-Chain Finance Forum for the AI Era
entry.summary: 「AI時代を見据えたオンチェーン金融フォーラム」（第１回）議事次第 金融庁 · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency held the first meeting of the On-Chain Finance Forum for the AI Era on September 30, 2026, with reports from relevant ministries and a discussion session. The forum aims to promote on-chain finance built on blockchain technology alongside existing off-chain financial infrastructure, with an interim report planned for early 2027. The meeting materials also cover stablecoins, tokenized deposits, and pilot projects in securities and trade settlement, along with overseas developments.

entry.title: Notice of Names of Unregistered Crypto Asset Exchange Operators (Japan FSA)
entry.summary: 無登録で暗号資産交換業を行う者の名称等の公表 金融庁 · Oct 7, 2026 · Crypto The Japan Financial Services Agency published names and details of domestic and overseas operators to which it issued warnings for conducting crypto asset exchange business without registration. The list shows trade names, addresses, business content and publication dates. The FSA notes listed operators may not reflect current status and urges users to confirm registration before use.

entry.title: Minutes of the First Meeting of the 'On-Chain Finance Forum for the AI Era' Published
entry.summary: 「AI時代を見据えたオンチェーン金融フォーラム」（第１回）議事録の公表 金融庁 · Oct 19, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency published the minutes of the first meeting of the 'On-Chain Finance Forum for the AI Era,' held on September 30, 2026, chaired by Minister Katayama. At the meeting, the FSA, Digital Agency, Ministry of Finance, Bank of Japan, and Japanese Bankers Association reported on on-chain finance efforts, including stablecoins, tokenized deposits, and tokenization of government bonds. ​

entry.title: SFC and AFRC sign new MoU extending financial reporting cooperation to licensed firms and funds
entry.summary: SFC and AFRC extend regulatory cooperation to financial reporting of licensed firms and funds under new MoU SFC · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The Securities and Futures Commission and the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council signed a new memorandum of understanding expanding their cooperation beyond listed entities. It covers financial and compliance reporting by licensed corporations, licensed virtual asset service providers, authorised funds and registered open-ended fund companies, along with related audit work. The MoU sets a framework for information sharing, case referrals, mutual assistance and coordinated inspections, and supersedes the 2021 agreement.

entry.title: ESMA Sets 2027 Work Priorities to Simplify and Integrate EU Capital Markets
entry.summary: ESMA sets 2027 priorities for stronger, simpler and more integrated EU capital markets ESMA · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has published its 2027 Annual Work Programme. It expands supervision of benchmark administrators and ESG rating providers, and advances simplification of reporting and supervisory frameworks. The plan also covers supervisory convergence for crypto-asset service providers under MiCA and the move to T+1 settlement on 11 October 2027.[Generated summary]

entry.title: ESMA urges MiCA changes to clarify rules, strengthen safety and cover new crypto services
entry.summary: ESMA calls for changes to make MiCA clearer, safer and ready for emerging services ESMA · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority has responded to the European Commission's consultation on reviewing the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA). It proposes simplifying the framework while strengthening investor protection, including stricter marketing rules and cost transparency. It also addresses decentralised finance, staking, lending and borrowing, and recommends stronger supervisory powers and binding token classification opinions.

entry.title: ESMA sets supervisory expectations for services linked to non-compliant stablecoins
entry.summary: ESMA sets out supervisory expectations on services related to unauthorised stablecoins ESMA · Oct 8, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority has issued an opinion on crypto-asset services involving stablecoins (asset-referenced and e-money tokens) that do not comply with MiCA. It says MiCA-authorised crypto-asset service providers should stop providing services related to such non-compliant stablecoins to EU clients. National authorities should supervise market participants and require remediation of any remaining exposures within three months of publication.

entry.title: ADGM FSRA seeks feedback on proposed DeFi risk management guidance
entry.summary: ADGM FSRA Invites Industry Feedback on Proposed DeFi Risk Management Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority published Consultation Paper No. 5 of 2026 on proposed DeFi risk management guidance. It sets out expectations for how authorised persons and recognised bodies should identify, assess, monitor and manage risks from engaging with DeFi protocols and venues, covering governance, due diligence, financial crime controls and client asset safeguards. Comments are due by 30 November 2026 and may be sent to fsra.consultation@adgm.com.

entry.title: Hong Kong SFC approves first secondary trading of tokenised public funds
entry.summary: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds SFC · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The SFC approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform. Two existing SFC-authorised tokenised money market funds can now be traded around the clock. The SFC set out requirements and safeguards for such trading in an April 2026 circular, covering the trading channel, fair pricing, liquidity provision and disclosure.

entry.title: 3iQ Receives In-Principle Approval for ADGM Category 4 License
entry.summary: 3iQ Receives In-Principle Approval from Abu Dhabi’s IFC 12 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 12, 2026 · Crypto 3iQ's UAE subsidiary, 3iQ Middle East Ltd, has received in-principle approval for a Category 4 license from the Financial Services Authority (FSRA) of ADGM, the Abu Dhabi international financial centre. The company says this is part of its aim to be regulated and present in major digital asset hubs worldwide.

entry.title: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Proposed Rules for Crypto Asset Transactions and Crypto Asset Markets
entry.summary: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Relating to Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets CFTC · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC has published an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking seeking public comment on a planned comprehensive framework for retail commodity transactions involving crypto assets under section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act. The notice asks how the Commission can prevent abusive practices, provide crypto-specific guidance on industry best practices, and codify a designated contract market subcategory called a crypto asset market. Comments are due within 60 days of Federal Register publication.

entry.title: Economic Secretary to the Treasury speech at UK Digital Assets Week
entry.summary: Economic Secretary to the Treasury speech for UK Digital Assets Week HMRC / gov.uk · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The UK Economic Secretary to the Treasury gave a speech at UK Digital Assets Week arguing for faster digitalisation of financial markets. She reports that HSBC and ClearToken have received approval to operate in the Digital Securities Sandbox and that a digital gilt, DIGIT, is planned for pilot issuance in 2027. The speech also outlines the UK's cryptoasset and stablecoin regulatory framework.

entry.title: Comptroller of the Currency seeks comment on a new information collection for applications to issue payment stablecoins under the GENIUS Act
entry.summary: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Information Collection; Submission for OMB Review; Applications for Licensing or Registration To Issue Payment Stablecoins Under the GENIUS Act Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) gives notice of a new information collection for entities seeking to issue payment stablecoins in the United States under the GENIUS Act. The collection has been sent to the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for review, and the public may submit comments within the stated period. The notice also lists the factors the OCC will use to evaluate applications, including the applicant's financial condition, officers' compliance records, and redemption and risk management policies.

entry.title: Cboe BZX Exchange proposes rule changes creating listing standards for options on multi-crypto-asset trusts and allowing options on ETFs
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 19.3 and Rule 19.4 To Establish Generic Listing Criteria and Continued Listing Standards for Options on Commodity-Based Trusts Holding Multiple Crypto Assets and To Permit the Listing of Options on Exchange-Traded Funds Federal Register · Oct 16, 2026 · Crypto Cboe BZX Exchange filed with the SEC a proposal to amend Rules 19.3 and 19.4 to set generic listing and continued listing standards for options on shares of commodity-based trusts holding multiple crypto assets. The proposal also permits options on exchange-traded funds as defined under Rule 6c-11 of the Investment Company Act. It was filed as non-controversial and became effective upon publication, with comments due by November 6, 2026.

entry.title: Proposed rule implementing the Federal Reserve Board's responsibilities under the GENIUS Act
entry.summary: Implementing the Federal Reserve Board's Responsibilities Under the GENIUS Act Federal Register · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The Federal Reserve Board proposes regulations implementing the GENIUS Act for Board-supervised permitted payment stablecoin issuers and certain other entities under its jurisdiction. It also proposes rules implementing the tying prohibition in section 4(a)(8), which applies to all permitted payment stablecoin issuers. Comments are due by November 30, 2026.

entry.title: Federal Reserve proposal setting application procedures for supervised banks seeking approval for a subsidiary to issue payment stablecoins
entry.summary: Application Procedures for Board-Supervised Insured Depository Institutions Seeking Approval for a Subsidiary To Issue Payment Stablecoins Federal Register · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The Federal Reserve Board proposes rules under the GENIUS Act setting out how insured State member banks apply for Board approval for a subsidiary to issue payment stablecoins. The proposal would be added as subpart D of Regulation UU and would let the Board evaluate applications against statutory safety and soundness factors while limiting unnecessary burden on applicants. Comments are due by November 30, 2026.

entry.title: Interim rule setting forms and procedures for the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee to review state certifications
entry.summary: Forms and Procedures for Review of State Certifications by the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee Federal Register · Sep 30, 2026 · Crypto The Treasury Department, on behalf of the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee, issued an interim final rule establishing procedures and forms for reviewing certifications submitted by state payment stablecoin regulators under section 4(c) of the GENIUS Act. The rule takes effect September 30, 2026, but certifications will not be accepted until the information collection receives Paperwork Reduction Act approval, with Treasury to announce that date. Comments are due by November 30, 2026.

entry.title: Withdrawal of proposed special measure targeting international crypto asset mixing
entry.summary: Proposal of Special Measure Regarding Convertible Virtual Currency Mixing, as a Class of Transactions of Primary Money Laundering Concern; Withdrawal Federal Register · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto FinCEN withdrew its 2023 proposed rule and related finding that international convertible virtual currency (CVC) mixing is a class of transactions of primary money laundering concern under section 311 of the USA PATRIOT Act. The proposal would have required enhanced recordkeeping and reporting by covered financial institutions. FinCEN cited concerns that the broad definition of CVC mixing could chill legitimate activity and impose heavy reporting burdens, and said it will continue monitoring mixer activity.

entry.title: Withdrawal of proposed rule on transactions involving convertible virtual currency or digital assets
entry.summary: Requirements for Certain Transactions Involving Convertible Virtual Currency or Digital Assets; Withdrawal Federal Register · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto FinCEN is withdrawing a December 2020 proposed rule that would have required banks and money service businesses to report, keep records, and verify customer identity for certain convertible virtual currency transactions involving unhosted or covered wallets. It is also withdrawing an October 2023 proposal on international CVC mixing. FinCEN says it will continue to monitor CVC mixer activity.

entry.title: IEX Notice on Rule Change Setting Listing and Withdrawal Standards for Crypto Asset Trust Options and Amending IBIT Options Limits
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Establish Listing Standards and Withdrawal Criteria for Options on Commodity-Based Trusts Holding a Single Crypto Asset or Multiple Crypto Assets and To Amend Rules Regarding Position and Exercise Limits for Options on iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF Federal Register · Oct 7, 2026 · Crypto The SEC published a notice of a proposed rule change filed by Investors Exchange LLC (IEX). The proposal would establish listing and withdrawal criteria for options on commodity-based trusts holding one or more crypto assets, and amend position and exercise limits for options on the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF. It was filed ahead of the launch of IEX Options and designated as non-controversial.

entry.title: Treasury seeks comment on extending the Digital Assets Criteria Form for threat-information sharing
entry.summary: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Information-Sharing Initiative: Digital Assets Criteria Form Federal Register · Oct 9, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Treasury Department has published a notice requesting public comment on extending, without change, an information collection for its Information-Sharing Initiative: Digital Assets Criteria Form. The form verifies whether applicants are eligible to receive Treasury's non-public cyber threat information, collecting details such as identity, legal status, digital asset function, and cybersecurity maturity. Comments are due by December 8, 2026.

entry.title: Advance notice seeking comment on rules for crypto asset transactions and markets
entry.summary: Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets Federal Register · Oct 13, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission issued an advance notice of proposed rulemaking on developing rules under section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act for crypto asset transactions and markets. Public comments are due by December 14, 2026. The document defines a crypto asset and notes that certain payment stablecoins may not meet the Act's definition of commodity.

entry.title: OCC notice seeking comment on new reporting forms for permitted payment stablecoin issuers
entry.summary: Agency Information Collection Activities: Proposed Information Collection; Submission for OMB Review; Reporting Forms and Instructions for Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuers Subject to the Jurisdiction of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency published a notice of a new information collection covering weekly (Form PS-01) and quarterly (Form PS-02) reporting forms and instructions for permitted payment stablecoin issuers. The forms support compliance with the GENIUS Act and the OCC's final implementing rule. Public comments are due by November 23, 2026.

entry.title: OCC final rule implementing the GENIUS Act for stablecoin issuance by OCC-supervised entities
entry.summary: Implementing the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act for the Issuance of Stablecoins by Entities Subject to the Jurisdiction of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issues a final rule implementing the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoin issuance and related activities by entities under its jurisdiction, effective January 18, 2027. The document responds to about 328 public comments on the March 2026 proposal, covering reserve asset management, redemption, capital requirements and the yield prohibition. It also explains that BSA/AML requirements will be addressed in a separate rulemaking.

entry.title: HKSAR Government's fourth digital green bond offering
entry.summary: HKSAR Government’s Fourth Digital Green Bonds Offering HKMA · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The HKSAR Government priced about HK$20 billion of digital green bonds in HKD, RMB, USD and EUR under its Government Sustainable Bond Programme. The offering was oversubscribed, with subscription ratios of 1.3 to 11.3 times across the four currencies. The HKD tranche settled using tokenised deposits, which the release describes as a world first for a digital bond.
